[Q31 English repeat from page 11]
32- Which of the following equations is not balanced?
(A) 2H2+O2→2H2O (B) 2KClO3→2Kcl+3O2 (C) H2+Cl2→2HCl (D) Pb(NO3)2→PbO+NO2+O2

(A) 4 (B) 11 (C) 7 (D) 5
34- What is Philosopher's wool?
(A) ZnSO4 (B) ZnCl2 (C) ZnO (D) ZnS

notes: Q32 English option (B) prints '2Kcl' (lowercase l) instead of '2KCl' — a print typo, transcribed exactly as shown; Hindi block correctly shows '2KCl'.
